description: This file defines the TLSmarty class, a wrapper for the Smarty templating engine used in the TestLink project. It includes functions for status translation, template guard, and image set management, as well as configuration and plugin registration for Smarty.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: TestLink wrapper for Smarty templating engine, managing template directories, configurations, images, and Smarty plugin registration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TLSmarty instance, setting template directories, configuration parameters, images, and Smarty plugins.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Returns the current set of images used in templates.

methods.name: getImageSet
methods.description: Static method that returns a predefined set of image URLs for template use.
